description: Brug is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.aaenmaas.nl. Civil construction that provides passage for pedestrians, animals, vehicles and services above obstacles or between two points at an altitude above the ground. source: Aquo. Coverage: NL. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
